projects.name: TokenGoblin
projects.problem: LLM workloads need cost, usage, and routing data before teams can control inference spend.
projects.proof: Public ingestion benchmarks, cost and routing tests, and a repository-level CI workflow.

projects.name: ReadyLayer
projects.problem: AI-assisted delivery needs policy, review, and evidence before generated changes reach production.
projects.proof: Public policy contracts, evidence export documentation, test suites, and CI quality gates.

projects.name: veridag
projects.problem: Distributed execution needs explicit ordering, capability security, and cross-language conformance.
projects.proof: A public protocol specification, Quint formal models, test vectors, and dedicated conformance workflows.

projects.name: Settler
projects.problem: Payment, banking, and operational records diverge unless matching and evidence rules are explicit.
projects.proof: Public reconciliation benchmark source and checked-in snapshots, with CI and security-invariant workflows.
